narrative.intro: C J Mahan Construction reported $215M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. C J Mahan Construction has 12 awards this fiscal year and an average award size of $17.9M. C J Mahan Construction saw obligations up 247.4% year over year. C J Mahan Construction has concentrated work in Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction, which accounts for $212M of obligations this fiscal year. C J Mahan Construction also has smaller obligations in Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction and Ship Building and Repairing, at $3M and $204K respectively. C J Mahan Construction’s recent fiscal history shows fluctuations: FY21 obligations were $66.4M, FY22 obligations were $7.2M, FY23 obligations were $24.1M, FY24 obligations were $52.9M, and FY25 obligations were $61.9M. C J Mahan Construction’s FY2026 total so far is materially higher than any prior single-year total listed, and the current-year totals are partial, covering fiscal year to date.
